haiku.text: Reproduced locally: pumpAndSettle never returns after sign-in. I considered three explanations. Ruled out: the magic link is never delivered — falsified, because the mail catcher shows it delivered 1.2s after the request and I observed the tap handler fire. Ruled out: the sign-in network call hangs — falsified, because the captured request log shows a 200 in 300ms. Supported: an indeterminate progress indicator keeps the frame permanently dirty — a widget tree dump captured during the hang shows LinearProgressIndicator with value:null while the outbox holds a pending row.
